items.text: All 12 workshop decisions (R1 d1-d4, R2 d1-d4, R3 d1-d4) have been incorporated into the plan. R3 additions: default-collapsed clusters on initial load (R3 d1=A), single aggregated edge per type with count badge for collapsed clusters (R3 d2=A), two convenience endpoints only — capture-to-item and initiative members (R3 d3=A), single clustering-utils.ts module with pure functions and collapse state in graph-ui-store (R3 d4=A).

Plan updated: Phase 3 confirmed clustering-utils module structure. Phase 5 now specifies collapsed-by-default initialization and count-badge edge aggregation. Contract Decisions section expanded with all 4 R3 decisions. Testing Plan includes aggregated edge count badge tests and default-collapsed store initialization test. Definition of Done expanded with collapsed-by-default and count badge line items.

No remaining gaps. All 5 readiness dimensions score 3/3: problem is fully understood with codebase-level specifics, scope is bounded with acceptance_allow globs, all 8 implementation phases have concrete steps with settled decisions, testing plan covers API + unit + component + store layers, and all identified risks have mitigations tied to workshop decisions.

plan_updates: Incorporated R3 d1-d4 decisions: added default-collapsed cluster state to Target End State and Phase 5, updated edge aggregation to count-badge approach in Cluster Interaction and Phase 5, confirmed two-endpoint scope in Scope and Convenience API sections, confirmed clustering-utils module structure in Phase 3. Added 4 new Contract Decision entries for R3. Updated Testing Plan with count-badge and default-collapsed tests. Expanded Definition of Done with 3 new line items (collapsed-by-default, count badges, convenience endpoints).
